identity.title: [v0.91.8][WP-10] Implement thin ADL CLI and authoritative selector

values.goal: Implement a small ADL v2 owner CLI that delegates validate, schema, plan, run, inspect, sign, and verify to reviewed WP-04 through WP-09 libraries, plus an authoritative atomic generation selector and stable installer with explicit verified rollback.
values.required_outcome: The independent adl-cli crate and installer provide deterministic JSON command envelopes, stable exit behavior, exact-digest installation and explicit compare-and-swap generation selection and rollback without duplicating language, compiler, engine, records, Runtime, provider, governed-tool, or lifecycle authority.
declared_scope: adl-v2/crates/adl-cli typed command tree and thin upstream adapters
generation selector record, lock, compare-and-swap transaction, deterministic receipt, inspect, select, and explicit rollback primitives
adl-v2/tools/install-adl-v2.sh stable exact-digest installation and receipt contract
machine-readable stdout and diagnostic/observability stderr separation
offline command, selector, installer, interruption, concurrency, rollback, dependency, budget, and stable-install proof
issue-local lifecycle, design, diagram, validation, review, and evidence records
authority_boundary: Issue #5345 owns only adl-v2/crates/adl-cli, adl-v2/tools/install-adl-v2.sh, and issue-local C-SDLC records
WP-04 through WP-09 public APIs, schemas, execution plans, effects, records, and adapters are read-only dependencies and are not reimplemented
The CLI selects no generation implicitly, performs no undeclared network or credential access, and owns no runtime administration or C-SDLC command
The selector verifies exact installed executable and receipt identity before one atomic compare-and-swap mutation; rollback is an explicit transaction, never silent fallback
Issue #5343 owns default cutover and issue #5344 owns soak and rollback acceptance; WP-10 supplies primitives but grants no cutover authority
Runtime v2 and incumbent ADL are behavioral evidence only and must not be imported, copied, linked, or modified
operator_constraints: Use installed typed C-SDLC v2 binaries and semantic card operations only
Keep the primary checkout clean on main; all tracked #5345 work stays in the dedicated issue worktree
Do not use raw gh, AWS, credentials, live providers, Runtime v2, or product implementation during preparation
Do not implement until #5339, #5338, #5340, #5342, #5341, and #5349 are each GitHub merged, typed closed_out, receipt-backed, and ancestral to the implementation revision
Use /Volumes/FastWork for every Cargo artifact, cache, and temporary build surface
Install accepted operational binaries outside Cargo target directories
Run bounded preparation review now and mandatory exact-revision code review before publication
Preparation may be committed and pushed, but no PR may be opened and no publication may occur in this preparation-only task
